name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering system
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from overload and carry on serving when the connection breaks. The ordering app for the food truck team.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool with which your team runs service.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, then mark the order first as ready, then as collected.

■ Don’t promise a time you won’t make
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how much time it needs. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s capabilities.

■ Take orders on the spot
Add orders taken on the spot to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen shows what needs preparing now, what’s next and what’s ready, and warns you when it’s time to start an order.

■ Order ticket printing
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

■ Carry on serving when the connection breaks
Switch on offline protection: if the connection breaks, pre-orders pause, so nobody can place an order you won’t see. Orders taken on the device are kept and synced when the connection is restored.

■ Made for the food truck
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Leave the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan the week
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck owners and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
whatsNew:
